keyFeatures.title: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: Powerful Seedream 5.0 Lite AI image generation capabilities

photorealistic.title: Photorealistic Quality
photorealistic.description: Generate images that look like professional photography. Accurate skin textures, natural lighting, realistic environments—without the uncanny valley effect common in AI images.

complexScene.title: Complex Scene Understanding
complexScene.description: Describe detailed scenarios with multiple subjects, spatial relationships, and specific lighting. The model interprets composition, positioning, and atmosphere accurately from your text.

bilingual.title: Bilingual Prompts
bilingual.description: Write in English, Chinese, or both. The model understands nuanced descriptions in either language equally well—useful for Chinese cultural references or specific terminology.

fastGeneration.title: Fast Generation
fastGeneration.description: Generate high-resolution images in seconds. The Lite model is optimized for speed, making it ideal for real-time creative exploration and iteration.

styleFlexibility.title: Style Flexibility
styleFlexibility.description: Create photorealistic images, anime illustrations, oil paintings, watercolors, 3D renders, and more. Specify your desired style in the prompt or let the model match the subject matter.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Seedream 5.0 Lite Text to Image

q1.question: What is Seedream 5.0 Lite?
q1.answer: Seedream 5.0 Lite is ByteDance's lightweight AI image generation model. It offers fast, high-quality image generation from text descriptions with optimized performance.

q2.question: How detailed should my prompt be?
q2.answer: More detail generally means better results. Include subject, setting, lighting, style, mood, and camera angle. Start with a few sentences and add more if needed.

q3.question: What styles can it generate?
q3.answer: Photorealistic, anime, oil painting, watercolor, 3D render, sketch, and more. Specify style in your prompt or reference specific artists and studios.

q4.question: Does it support Chinese prompts?
q4.answer: Yes, Seedream 5.0 Lite understands both English and Chinese equally well. You can write prompts in either language or mix both.

q5.question: What's the difference from Seedream 5?
q5.answer: Seedream 5.0 Lite is a lightweight version optimized for faster generation speed while maintaining high image quality. It's ideal for quick iterations and cost-effective usage.
